'''Hoth Command''' was a military command element of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that oversaw Imperial military operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial|[HEROIC 2+] Static|Hoth}}</ref>
